product_summary: Website (vezbynature.com, homepage only - all sub-pages returned 404) describes a fruit & vegetable processor with corporate office in Bangalore, Karnataka and manufacturing facility in Chittoor, Andhra Pradesh. Stated product lines: (1) aseptic tropical fruit purees/pulps, pastes and concentrates - mango, tomato, papaya, white/pink guava, pineapple, grape, banana; (2) tomato paste; (3) IQF (individually quick frozen) fruit dices and frozen fruit/vegetables; (4) gherkins in brine solution and in acetic acid/vinegar for the B2B market; (5) fresh-grown vegetables and fresh mangoes/vegetables for export. Claimed processing capacities: 60k MT mango, 55k MT tomato, 20k MT pineapple, 15k MT grape per year. Claimed falling-film + forced-circulation technology, Italian plant, ~100,000 sqft facility. Claimed export markets: Europe, Asia, Middle East, Africa, US, Australia. Testimonials on site attributed to IFFA Group Qatar, Al Salala WLL Oman, Ben Wang PTE Singapore - these are marketing statements, not shipment evidence.
role_hint: manufacturer (own processing facility claimed at Chittoor, AP; own brand/plant technology described). Secondary trader/sourcing-agent activity is signalled by the 'fresh vegetables' and 'fresh mangoes' export line and by the 'B.Local' sourcing platform, which are not covered by an owned processing plant - so manufacturer_trader is the more accurate reading.
comment: HS mapping vs declaration: declared 071080 (frozen vegetables) - CORROBORATED by the IQF frozen vegetable line, exact. Declared 081190 (frozen fruit) - CORROBORATED by IQF fruit dices, exact. Declared 200799 (fruit purees/concentrates/jams) - CORROBORATED by the aseptic puree/pulp/concentrate range, exact. Declared 200110 (cucumbers/gherkins preserved by vinegar/acetic acid) - PARTIALLY corroborated: the site does state 'Gherkins In Brine Solution ... Acetic Acid/Vinegar', so 200110 is defensible for the vinegar-preserved gherkin pack, but the brine-only pack would fall under 0711 and the site does not distinguish the two. MISSING from the declaration: 200290 (tomato paste/puree concentrate) - the site explicitly names tomato paste and 55k MT/yr tomato processing, yet no 20.02 line is declared; this is the clearest gap. Also missing: 200190/0711 for the gherkin-in-brine line, and fresh-produce lines (0804 50 fresh mango, 0803 90 banana, 0804 30 pineapple, 0702 fresh tomato) which the site markets for export but which are absent from the declaration. Industry classification 'Food products & FMCG' is broadly correct but imprecise - this is a bulk/B2B fruit-and-vegetable processor and ingredient supplier (aseptic drums/bins, IQF cartons, brine drums), not an FMCG branded-goods company; the correct framing is 'processed fruit & vegetable ingredients / agro-processing'. Trader signs: the fresh-produce export line and the 'B.Local' sourcing platform imply sourcing-and-resale of goods not processed in-house, i.e. a trader component alongside manufacturing. Per project rules the HS mismatch is NOT a rejection ground - company is retained and codes corrected to the actual range above. All product claims here are from the company's own website only; no customs line, B/L or shipping record was reviewed in this task, therefore every product line above is 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. Note also that the site's sub-pages (products, IQF, fresh vegetables, certificates, contact) all returned HTTP 404 at the time of check, so the catalogue could not be verified in detail and the certificate claims (USFDA/EU standards) are unverifiable from the site itself. No registry, revenue or shipment-volume research was performed in this task, per scope.
